title: CityBench: Evaluating the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Urban Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on urban tasks, such as mobility prediction and street view image geolocalization, across 13 diverse global cities. The study investigates the correlation between task performance and a city's public online presence (approximated by the number of Google search results and Wikipedia entries), demonstrating that models perform significantly worse on lesser-known cities compared to major international hubs.
